Every build starts with 20 Badge slots across six disciplines; all 20 available immediately, tokens must be earned to fill them.
Physicals added as sixth discipline in 2K27.

records.value: Tokens earned via six discipline meters driven by live in-game performance, Team Practice drills, and Gatorade workouts.
records.notes: Progression tracked per discipline, not per badge.

records.value: Token cost per Badge varies with selected size and position; Builder shows real-time feedback on eligibility and cost as attributes/physicals change.
records.notes: Official mechanic-level confirmation that cost matrix varies by height/position; actual cost values not published officially.
Bonus Slots/Tokens can be applied to any discipline and re-applied later.
53 Badges in 2K27 including 19 brand-new. Full list with [NEW] markers published on O2 (see badge.*.name records).
19 new badges; 6 removed vs 2K26 per official roadmap restated in C7/C8. O2 marks each new badge [NEW].
Legend Badges cannot be obtained at build creation but can still be earned (via Synergy).
16 Synergy slots: twelve +1 boosts, four +2 boosts.

records.value: Fuse Badges receive a permanent +1 or +2 boost for the entire game, pushing a Badge beyond its current tier; placing a Badge in a Fuse slot frees the Badge Tokens that would have been spent to equip it.
records.notes: Fuse half of the Synergy system.

records.value: Reaction Badges are paired with Fuse Badges; effect triggers automatically once the Fuse Badge has been activated a set number of times during a game, then receives the same +1/+2 boost for the rest of the game.
records.notes: Reaction half of the Synergy system.
Synergy allows surpassing standard Badge limitations to reach Legend tier.
Synergy earning and expiry rules from O2.
Signature Blueprints is an all-new builder path replacing Pro-Tuned and NBA templates.
Each template shaped by three player comparisons blending attributes and animations. Official example: Bulldozer = LeBron James, Pascal Siakam, Scottie Barnes.
40 Signature Blueprint templates at launch, additional templates added each Season.
Swap active Loadout before tip-off without exiting to menu.

records.value: Cap Breakers return; once a build reaches 99 OVR in the Builder, a preview shows the exact boost each attribute receives per Cap Breaker; housed in the new Builder Glossary alongside Badges, Animations and Takeover Abilities info.
records.notes: Cap Breaker preview confirmed official.
Example quest: Level 5 Shooting requires corner threes.
24 Takeover Abilities detailed in Gameplay Courtside Report; Hydration Hero prevents Adrenaline/Stamina drain and fits any of the five slots.
Rebirth returns with four tiers tied into Badge Tokens.
First female MyPLAYERs; same attribute rules as male; selection locked once chosen. No official female-specific attribute numbers published.
Both C1 and C4 show four equippable tiers. Legend exists above HoF but is not equippable at creation (official, see mechanic.badges.legend_at_creation).
